ref_clues.ref_content: MSG_FIFO window (2kB range at 0x800) is a write-only message FIFO. Any write to this address range appends data to the FIFO. The FIFO's pass-through mode means that when the SHA engine is ready, write data passes through, keeping fifo_depth at 0 while fifo_empty toggles low for a cycle.

ref_clues.ref_content: STATUS register provides KMAC/SHA3 state. Fields: sha3_idle (bit0) - 1 if SHA3 engine idle. sha3_absorb (bit1) - 1 if receiving/processing message. sha3_squeeze (bit2) - 1 if sponge absorbing completed, SW can manually run engine. fifo_depth (bits12:8) - occupied entries in message FIFO. fifo_empty (bit14) - message FIFO empty indicator; due to pass-through mode, fifo_depth stays 0 but fifo_empty toggles low for a cycle then returns high. fifo_full (bit15) - message FIFO full indicator. ALERT_RECOV_CTRL_UPDATE_ERR (bit17) - 1 if an update error occurred in the shadowed Control Register.
